title: feat(nperppex): perpnn 1-seed later-tick exist-opposite: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: The band's one structural obstruction. On the perpnn 1-seed (origin, lock +e1) the x-probe cell has S_*(A)={+e1} and S_*(B)={+e1,+e2,+e3}, all positive, so reverse fails at the widest time window; I confirmed by independent recomputation that perpnn-x is the ONLY cell of the 30 seed x frame cells whose reverse still fails at the maximal readout (later-tick union own lock).
